Attribution.description:
Direction of the outcome (see mulebench.harness.attribution). A layer
next to the invariants, which judge policy; never changes them.
Attribution.title: Attribution

ConfirmationRecord.description:
One answer from the customer channel to a confirmation request.

Written by the harness's recording confirmer, never by guards.
ConfirmationRecord.title: ConfirmationRecord

Conformance.description:
Benign-control check of an external agent before attack numbers (see
mulebench.harness.conformance). Resistance means nothing without utility.
Conformance.title: Conformance

Disclosure.description:
Whether another customer's amounts reached a sink (see
mulebench.harness.disclosure). Descriptive; separate from INV-2. No text
is ever stored. The top-level fields are the union over `sinks`; reports
before per-sink checks have no `sinks` and judged the final answer only.
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

GuardDecision.description:
A guard verdict. `code` and `reason` are detailed and stay in the trace;
only `public_code` is shown to the agent.
GuardDecision.title: GuardDecision

InvariantResult.description:
`checked_transfers` and `checked_calls` count the items in scope; an
invariant that reads only one kind of evidence reports 0 for the other.
InvariantResult.title: InvariantResult

ModelCallRecord.description: One model call. Never contains model output text or thinking.
ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord

ServerMeta.description:
What a local model server reports about the model under test.

Fields a server does not expose are None (digest, quantization and version
come from Ollama-only endpoints).
ServerMeta.title: ServerMeta

SessionRun.description:
One session of a multi-session trial. Trace records, steps and
confirmations carry the same `index` in their `session` field.
SessionRun.title: SessionRun

Violation.description:
One broken rule.

`transfer_id` names the transfer the violation is about, `call_seq` the
tool call (trace sequence number). `transfer_ids` lists every transfer of a
group violation (INV-3 structuring). `all_authorized` is set only for
structuring: whether every transfer in the group cited an existing
authorization.
Violation.title: Violation
